intent.audience: IG/TikTok followers of the ร้านแว่นตีสอง cartoon, Thai, phone viewing
intent.message: The grandmother's gold glasses wait on the counter at 2 a.m. — someone will come back for them.
intent.story_context: ร้านแว่นตีสอง EP01: a ghost grandma's cracked gold-rimmed glasses were never picked up; the young optician repairs them overnight.
intent.scene_objective: Insert shot that makes the glasses the emotional object of the episode.
intent.subtext: waiting, a promise kept across years
constraints: headline space in the top area for the HTML layer

direction.visual_metaphor: a pair of glasses waiting like a person waits

primary_focal_point.what: a pair of small round gold-rimmed reading glasses, folded, resting on an old wooden shop counter in a pool of warm light that falls from outside the picture
primary_focal_point.where: lower half, slightly right of centre
primary_focal_point.how_emphasised: brightest highlight and warmest colour in the frame, sharpest detail

secondary_focal_point.what: a small paper envelope with a yellowed edge beside the glasses
secondary_focal_point.where: left of the glasses, slightly behind

viewing_path: gold glasses in the pool of warm light
dark glass cabinets fading into blue night
blueprint.subject_placement: glasses in the lower half just right of centre, warm light falling from the upper right

depth_layers.foreground: edge of the wooden counter, softly out of focus
depth_layers.midground: the glasses and the envelope on the counter
depth_layers.background: old glass display cabinets full of frames, dim and blue, with a wall clock

blueprint.negative_space: the top third of the picture is a plain dark wooden wall
blueprint.cropping: counter fills the lower 45 %; the light source stays outside the picture
blueprint.value_plan: low key: 70 % dark blue-brown masses, a single bright pool of warm light on the glasses

palette.proportion: ≈ 70 dark night blues / 20 warm wood / 10 gold-amber highlight

lighting.key_direction: from the upper right, out of frame
lighting.notes: cool blue moonlight from the shop window as fill on the far cabinets

environment: the inside of an old wooden two-storey shophouse optician shop in Bangkok at 2 a.m.

prompt.avoid: the image has no letters, no signs and no people; the glasses have exactly two round lenses joined by one thin bridge

outputs.generated_by: flux_local v3 (light from outside the picture; "no lamp" wording)
flux_local v3 (light from outside the picture; "no lamp" wording)
v4-1 + post: window darkened/desaturated (radial), fake signature inpainted (cv2)

critique.where: top-left window with the moon (x 0.27, y 0.25)
critique.problem: v4-1: the moonlit window was the most salient element (saliency 0.98), competing with the glasses
critique.likely_cause: cool-bright window + full moon = strongest local contrast
critique.fix: darken and desaturate the window area (done in v5: glasses become peaks 1–2)
critique.side_effects: less blue/warm contrast; keep a little blue so the night still reads

critique.problem: the yellowed envelope (secondary focal point, story clue) is missing in every take
critique.likely_cause: build_prompt.py dropped the secondary sentence (priority 4) to fit the word budget
critique.fix: raise secondary focal point to priority 2 (fixed in build_prompt.py) and regenerate, or composite an envelope layer
critique.side_effects: longer prompt; may pull attention from the glasses — keep it smaller and darker

critique.problem: reads as painterly digital illustration / anime background rather than gouache storybook
critique.likely_cause: FLUX default painterly look; gouache texture words weakly followed
critique.fix: add paper texture overlay in HTML, or try storybook_gouache with img2img from a gouache texture plate

critique.problem: glasses sit centre-left, not right of centre as planned
critique.likely_cause: models centre subjects; placement words are weak
critique.fix: accept (centre is a strong default — PalmerLab-Spatial) or crop 6 % from the left

critique.problem: v4-1 had a tiny fake signature scribble

score.rater: claude (provisional AI judgement, no viewer test)
